Location: Nghi Son Economic Zone, Thanh Hoa province (LNG regasification terminal serving the 1,500 MW Phase 1 / 4,500 MW total Cong Thanh CCGT power plant, a coal-to-LNG conversion)
_discovery_notes: Distinct from GEM's Nghi Son LNG Terminal (T100000131175, JERA-led, also in Nghi Son Economic Zone): different sponsor (Cong Thanh Thermal Power JSC), a coal-to-LNG conversion of the long-idle Cong Thanh coal project. Includes its own dedicated LNG regasification terminal (~1.2 Mt/yr) + import terminal + port, per restart reporting. Concrete step: agreement-in-principle / framework agreement signed with Doosan Enerbility (KR) and PECC2 late Aug 2025; foreign partners BP, Actis (UK), GE (US) reported. researcher_initials: AI-draft (discovery sweep). Consider AssociatedTerminals/AssociatedPowerPlant link to Cong Thanh power station (gem.wiki/Cong_Thanh_power_station). Capacity (1.2 Mt/yr) is single-source (trade press), marked yellow.
